executive_summary.text: Q1 2026 showed mixed digital performance: Instagram reach rose sharply (+65% QoQ), while Facebook views fell (-27% QoQ) and LinkedIn impressions dropped (-36% QoQ). Publication output increased markedly (+150% QoQ) and email engagement improved, but overall KPI reporting fell sharply. Data gaps limit deeper insight.

key_findings.statement: Instagram reach increased to 10,525, up 65.1% from Q4 2025.
Facebook views declined to 3,686, down 26.9% from Q4 2025.
LinkedIn total impressions fell to 18,911, a 35.8% drop from Q4 2025.
Verified publications rose to 35, a 150% increase from Q4 2025.

kpi_analysis.interpretation: Only 1 KPI was recorded this quarter, a 95.7% decline from Q4 2025, indicating a major drop in KPI tracking completeness.
Email engagement rate improved to 13.7%, up 14.6% QoQ, suggesting better content relevance.
Open rate jumped to 52.8%, up 124% QoQ, though may be inflated by privacy protections.
Instagram profile visits rose 21.7% QoQ to 275, indicating increased audience interest.
Facebook interactions fell 38.5% QoQ to 352, reflecting reduced audience activity.
LinkedIn engagement rate slipped to 8.7%, down 8% QoQ, showing weaker audience interaction.

website.summary: Website data not connected; no analysis possible.

social.summary: Instagram metrics improved, while Facebook and LinkedIn metrics declined.

findings.statement: Instagram reach up 65.1% QoQ; Facebook views down 26.9% QoQ; LinkedIn impressions down 35.8% QoQ.
Instagram link clicks rose 38.1% QoQ to 29, but LinkedIn clicks fell 42.2% QoQ to 1,020.

email.summary: Email activity increased with higher engagement and open rates.

findings.statement: Email campaigns doubled QoQ to 2; engagement rate rose to 13.7% (+14.6% QoQ).
Open rate surged to 52.8% (+124% QoQ) while click‑to‑open fell to 25.9% (-48.8% QoQ).

media.summary: Media mentions recorded for the quarter but no prior comparison.

findings.statement: Five press entries and nine total media items were logged in Q1 2026.
35 verified publications, a 150% rise QoQ, with 91.4% open‑access share.

events.summary: No Eventbrite events were held or scheduled.

findings.statement: Event count and capacity both remained at zero.

conferences.summary: Conference participation recorded without prior baseline.

findings.statement: Eight conference entries logged, including 16 posters and 8 oral presentations.
Only 1 KPI recorded versus 23 in Q4 2025.

trends.statement: Instagram reach and link clicks show upward momentum, while Facebook and LinkedIn metrics trend downward.

cross_dataset.statement: Improved email engagement coincides with higher Instagram activity, suggesting coordinated digital outreach.

risks.statement: Sharp decline in KPI reporting (95.7% QoQ) risks loss of performance visibility.
Facebook audience metrics fell markedly, indicating potential disengagement on that platform.

opportunities.statement: Instagram’s strong reach growth can be leveraged for broader campaign dissemination.
High open‑access share of publications (91.4%) can enhance research impact and visibility.

recommendations.recommendation: Prioritise KPI tracking reinstatement to restore comprehensive performance monitoring.
recommendations.reasoning: Only one KPI recorded this quarter, limiting insight into programme effectiveness.

recommendations.recommendation: Allocate resources to sustain Instagram growth while developing strategies to re‑engage Facebook audiences.
recommendations.reasoning: Instagram reach rose sharply, but Facebook views fell 26.9% QoQ.
recommendations.expected_benefit: Balanced multi‑platform presence and audience reach.

recommendations.recommendation: Capitalize on high email open rates by expanding targeted email campaigns and integrating cross‑channel promotion.
recommendations.reasoning: Open rate increased to 52.8% and engagement to 13.7%, indicating receptive audience.

data_gaps: Website analytics not connected; events_calendar lacks date fields; content_themes missing; partnerships only headline figure; awards and campaigns datasets unavailable.

best_performing.statement: Instagram reach (+65.1% QoQ) and email open rate (+124% QoQ) were the strongest positive changes.
